title: Networks I + LLM foundations I
objective: TCP/IP, TCP vs UDP, DNS, TLS, sockets, HTTP/1.1 vs 2 vs 3, WebSockets vs SSE vs WebRTC. Then the conceptual core of LLMs and your first LLM app (Ed Donner Week 1).
topics: Cloud architecture: regions, AZs, ALB, DNS, TLS, CloudFront
TCP handshake, reliability, flow/congestion control; UDP
WebSockets vs SSE vs long-polling vs WebRTC
LLMs: tokens, BPE, context windows, next-token prediction, why hallucination
Ed Donner Wk1: first LLM app (brochure generator)
theory: Karpathy Intro to LLMs + Deep Dive.
practice: Networking experiments with curl/dig/openssl; first LLM app.
deliverables: Ed Donner Week 1 project running locally
checkpoint: Narrate DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP → render
Choose WebSockets vs SSE for LLM streaming and defend it

knowledge: What problem does HTTP/3 solve that HTTP/2 could not?
What is a token and why are prices per token?
practical: Kth Largest Element in a Stream + Task Scheduler cold
Run the Week 1 app with cost logging

Weekly review: answer this week’s knowledge questions aloud, run the practical checks, then write the three notes (struggled / learned / improve) in Weekly Plan → Review. Update the tracking sheet.

JS/MERN spaced recall (Cycle 1 · explain + implement) · Event loop & async ordering: Draw call stack + micro/macro task queues, then write 5 ordering snippets mixing setTimeout / Promise.then / queueMicrotask / async-await; predict, run, fix your model. Log misses in mistakes.md; if you fail the check, redo the matching module in Side Tracks → 🟨 JavaScript & MERN Refresher.
